title: Playing Bias: Epistemic Games for Interpreting Text-to-Image Models
title_zh: 玩转偏见：用于解读文生图模型的认识论游戏

paragraphs.en: 提出解读、质询、揭露三阶段认识论游戏，帮助美术学生在实践中识别和批判文生图模型编码的偏见。 Text-to-image (T2I) systems do not merely render prompts; they circulate defaults for "what X looks like," shaping recognition through pose, camera, costume, props, and setting. While technical audits quantify disparities, they rarely cultivate the literacy needed to argue how images assemble stereotypes and confer authority. This paper translates a three-stage, humanities-informed framework into a set of epistemic games that make this cultural work visible and debatable: Interpret (art-historical close looking with AI outputs), Interrogate (counter-intent prompting as artistic exploration), and Expose (creative misuse through paired prompts with a constant motif and a BiasSlot rule, in which only the bias cue varies). In a pilot with undergraduate fine-arts students, the games shifted discussion from impressionistic reactions to concise, warranted hypotheses grounded in visual evidence, supported by lightweight classroom instruments that enabled reproducibility and structured collaboration. We argue that such game-based approaches foster critical literacy across educational contexts, equipping learners to recognize, discuss, and contest how T2I models encode bias.
paragraphs.zh: 提出解读、质询、揭露三阶段认识论游戏，帮助美术学生在实践中识别并批判文生图模型所编码的偏见。文生图系统并非仅仅渲染提示词，它们还在传播“X 长什么样”的默认设定，通过姿态、镜头、服装、道具和场景塑造人们的认知。 尽管技术审计能够量化差异，却很少培养出那种能论证图像如何组装刻板印象并赋予权威的素养。 本文将一个由人文学科启发的三阶段框架转化为一组认识论游戏，使这种文化工作变得可见且可辩论：解读（以艺术史式的细读审视 AI 输出）、质询（以反意图提示作为艺术探索）、揭露（通过恒定母题加 BiasSlot 规则的成对提示进行创造性误用，其中只有偏见线索发生变化）。 在一项面向本科美术专业学生的试验中，这些游戏将讨论从印象式的反应转变为基于视觉证据的、简明且有依据的假设，并借助轻量的课堂工具实现了可复现性和结构化的协作。 我们认为，此类基于游戏的方法能够在各类教育情境中培养批判性素养，使学习者具备识别、讨论和质疑文生图模型如何编码偏见的能力。
